CHOOSE BY WORKFLOW

Three ways to make the decision.

01

Tipo can be a good fit for a service business whose requirements align with its ten-service Basic tier or unlimited Pro tier. Count the services and staff you will publish before comparing costs.

02

For group sessions, test participant categories and quantity discounts against your ticket rules. A family booking and a per-person workshop may require different capacity calculations.

03

If you need a particular meeting platform or partial-payment rule, obtain a concrete example from support. Compare confirmed behavior with Cowlendar's listed Zoom, Teams and deposit capabilities rather than marking an undocumented feature as absent.

SEE THE PRODUCT

Tipo, in its own words and screens.

This product image comes from Tipo’s official Shopify listing. Use the live demo and documentation to confirm your particular setup.

View the official listing ↗

Before you switch, test these four things.

  1. Recreate a real booking. Include duration, buffer time, capacity and the assigned person or resource.
  2. Trigger a conflict. Block the same time in a connected calendar and verify the storefront response.
  3. Follow the money. Make a test payment, then cancel and check how the booking and refund are handled separately.
  4. Protect upcoming appointments. Confirm the import method with support, reconcile future bookings, and switch only after the new flow passes.
